notes.title: New more accurate flight controls, land on tree branches, fancy realtime GI.
notes.content:
[h1]New controls, play the tutorial![/h1]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b] New flight controls for Roll/Yaw that more accurately fit bird flight mechanics into the limits of 3-tracker VR. The old way of rolling was too far off from how birds actually roll. See tutorial for the new controls. [/b]
[*] More aggressive auto detect graphics to improve defaults on lower end systems like the minimum requirements.
[*] Enable Lumen real-time GI at Epic GI quality.
[*] Improved reflections on ocean above Low quality.
[*] Start position randomized.
[*] Adjusted quality settings for use more consistent temporal up-scaling.
[*] Tutorial updated with new controls and simplified a bit.
[*] Updated to UE 5.4.4
[*] New trees with individual branches you can land on. Feels more birdy.
[*] Optimized various prop meshes and environment materials.
[*] Welcome to The Cube
[*] Improved foliage shading.
[*] Rewrote and added proper physics/collisions to bird head movents when you land and peck at stuff on the ground.
[*] Fixed feathers that were too dark
[*] Fixed beak jitter
[*] Optimized post process shaders
[*] Fixed cases of getting stuck after landing on trees or facing into a steep hill.
[*] The Tutorial Lads(tm) only live in the tutorial now instead of the main menu.
[*] Improved nighttime visibility when the moon is out. The darkest times of night are still very dark.
[/list]

Pls let me know how it's working for you [url=https://discord.gg/Z4H7EacA88]on Discord[/url].

notes.title: The Big Update is here.
notes.content:
A complete rewrite of You Are a Bird in Unreal Engine 5.
Massive quality improvement in all areas.
Realtime procgen is out in favor of much more detailed 56 square km island.

The "beta" branch has been disabled as it's no longer needed.
If you still want to play the old version, it's available in an optional branch called "unity"

notes.title: Unreal Engine 5 Beta
notes.content:
I spent the past 100,000,000 years remaking YAaB in Unreal Engine 5 and you can try it ~right now~

[h1]Beta features[/h1]
Expect bugs and performance issues at this stage.
[list]
[*] Calibration eliminated!
[*] Better wing controls: roll naturally with your wrist instead of triggers
[*] Temporal Super Resolution - save on FPS by turning down render resolution without much visual quality loss
[*] Better lighting with extremely long distance shadows
[*] Better day/night sky graphics
[*] High quality volumetric clouds you can fly through and above
[*] Dynamic weather system with rain, thunder, lightning, fog, and cloud coverage
[*] Weather clears above the cloud layer
[*] Better flight physics
[*] Proper graphics options
[*] Little tutorial guys
[*] Returning to massive [i]finite[/i] landscapes with more human touch in their design.
Infinite procedural generated landscapes are being removed because they are too much of a performance burden and not reliable with some of the new landscape features like rivers, waterfalls, and mountain lakes that I'm working on.
[*] Better grass
[*] Better groundcover
[*] Better ambient audio
[*] Fast-forward time from the popup menu
[*] Better landscape detail
[*] OpenXR instead of the older SteamVR/Oculus targets
[/list]
These features from the Unity version are not in the UE5 Beta yet but I'm working on it:
[list]
[*] Talon controls
[*] Hunting rabbits
[*] Glowy deer
[/list]

[h1]How to opt into the Beta[/h1]
[previewyoutube=OI-lpMSCsCs;full][/previewyoutube]
In your Library:
Right click [i]You Are A Bird[/i]
Click [i]Properties[/i]
Click [i]Betas[/i]

Close [i]Properties[/i]
Wait for the update to complete.

If the Beta is not working on your PC yet, just set [i]Beta Participation[/i] back to [i]None[/i] to play the old version.

notes.title: You Are A Bird - Massive World Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862140/0c17093dcabcae032b54e790aed3b8e71c24c4b6.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added roll to the flight system, squeeze your triggers to gently roll to either side.
[*] Flight math re-written for smoother flight and better control.
[*] Added infinite procedural world generation.
[*] World regenerates from a fresh seed every game.
[*] A bunch of new music added.
[*] Revamped day-night system with a dynamic sky and atmospheric fog.
[*] Improved main menu.
[*] Max render distance raised to 5000.
[*] Volumetric clouds disabled while I work on their performance issues.
[*] Pitch limit disabled while I work out bugs.
[*] New shadow rendering system.
[/list]

notes.title: April update is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862140/2dfa25d869798245d72ed0b7ec2b372217f5e379.png[/img]

Hey friends, the April update is here!
It took a ton of work to get this running but there's finally a new massive island to build the rest of the game on.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Your settings and calibration from previous versions will be lost. Please update settings and re-run calibration from the main menu.

[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Way bigger ~4 square km island with giant mountain peaks.
[*] New more detailed trees with branches you can perch among.
[*] Brought player's eye distance closer to that of a bird so you feel more bird-sized.
[*] Volumetric clouds you can fly through just below the mountain peaks.
[*] Lightweight volumetric sun shafts.
[*] Dive speed increased.
[*] Tons of manual optimization and a new LOD system to get this island running.
[*] Misc physics and wildlife bugfixes and tweaks.
[*] Less cluttered main menu.
[/list]

Please try it out and [url=https://discord.gg/MeRzHQF]let me know what you think[/url]. c:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862140/04d6ca140c77e5ac33853736fbc8d47b03222fd8.png[/img]

notes.title: You Are A Bird - v0.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Excited to finally get the first update out to you!
Please try it out and [url=https://discord.gg/MeRzHQF]let me know what you think[/url], many of these and a lot more in-progress changes come from player feedback. 

[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Day-night Cycle - 24 hour cycle with new dynamic light and sound.
[*] Better Eating - Peck chunks from your prey and tilt your head up to swallow.
[*] Hunger and Starvation - Get hungry over time, eventually starving if you don't eat for too long. A minimally-intrusive hunger meter shows up when necessary.
[*] New in-flight music.
[/list]
[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] Controller Calibration - if the angle you need to hold your controllers at feels off, try this from the main menu. If you play on Index especially give this a try.
[*] Pitch Limit - option for new players that find themselves flipping over too often.
[/list]
[b]Technical / Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Higher quality dynamic lighting with several re-written/new shaders.
[*] More efficient single-pass instanced rendering.
[*] UI quality improved, smooth movement, does not clip through scenery.
[*] Misc bugfixes.
[*] Flight model improvements, prep for future flight mechanics.
[/list]
